svg.title: BEE 3101 End of Semester (25 Oct 2024) — Figure Q2: two perfect dielectrics
svg.desc: A rectangular box divided by a vertical line into Region 1 on the left and Region 2 on the right, with a single horizontal arrow running left to right through both — the propagation axis and the boundary normal. Region 1 carries eta-1 = 300 ohm, an incident field E_xi1 = 100 V/m, and sigma-1 = 0. Region 2 carries eta-2 = 100 ohm. The conductivity in Region 2 is printed with subscript 1 as well, which is an error in the paper: it should be sigma-2 = 0. Required: the incident, reflected and transmitted powers.
svg.text: BEE 3101 End of Semester (25 Oct 2024), Q2(b) — redrawn as printed.
Called “Figure Q1” in the text (P6); Region 2’s conductivity is printed with subscript 1 (P7).
